I’m Guozhi Ye, a master’s student at the University of Pennsylvania studying Applied Economics and Data Science (AEDS). My academic interests focus on macroeconomic analysis, business analytics, and data-driven decision-making. I enjoy using economic reasoning and quantitative methods to better understand real-world business and economic problems. Alongside my graduate studies, I am developing practical technical skills in R, SQL, and Git to strengthen my ability to work with data, conduct reproducible analysis, and collaborate on analytical projects. Looking ahead, I hope to pursue a career that combines economics, data analysis, and business strategy.
